note: Lesson 7.6 is about launch and adoption; it's shown as steps.

walk.title: Solve it: making Kora's team actually use the CRM

steps.say: A CRM nobody uses is just an expensive spreadsheet. We test it with the people who'll use it, train them on their own deals, and measure adoption.
UAT week. Twenty-two test scripts from the twelve musts, run by Bisi, the office managers and two champions. Nine defects fixed, seven requests logged for later.
Training by role, on each person's own migrated deals, plus six short videos. Tunde and Amaka are the champions in each office.
Three dashboards for agents, managers and the owner. The Monday meeting moves from Excel to the owner dashboard from week one.
show: Each chart answers a written question

steps.say: Track adoption weekly. In week three, nine of twelve agents log activity, and first reply is down to nineteen minutes from six hours.
Handover in week four. Two admins trained, hypercare closes, and a monthly optimisation retainer starts.

walk.end: That's launch: tested by its users, trained on real deals, measured every week, and handed over with admins in place.
